summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K on May 27, 2026, attaching a press release disclosing routine share transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities (PDMR) and their closely associated persons. Specifically, Non-Executive Director Serpil Timuray and her PCA Abdurrahman Murat Timuray acquired 47 ordinary shares each at £43.718739 per share on May 26, 2026, through reinvestment of dividend income on the London Stock Exchange. The filing is a standard PDMR notification under UK market abuse regulation, not a special situation such as a tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or strategic review. No board recommendation, advisor, special terms, or structural changes referenced. This is a routine compliance filing. What to watch: none.
